lyrics:
[Intro: muted trumpet hook, congas, soft kick]

[Verse 1: light male tenor, off-beat guitar]
She packs the bag before I'm even up
Two towels, cold water, my book, her cup
I burn like paper, she knows that well
She's got the bottle open before I can tell

[Pre-Chorus: bass enters, handclaps]
Turn around, she says. Hold still.

[Chorus: full groove, trumpet answers each line]
That's SPF love
Hands on my shoulders, got me covered up
Every inch she knows I'd miss
Back of my neck, and then a kiss
Nobody looks out for me like this
SPF love

[Drop: trumpet melody and marimba, no vocal]

[Verse 2: tenor, groove a little fuller]
I get her ears and the part in her hair
The backs of her knees, she can't reach there
Twenty years in, it's my favorite chore
I take it slow, then I do some more

[Pre-Chorus: bass and handclaps]
Turn around, I say. Hold still.

[Chorus: full groove, trumpet answers each line]
That's SPF love
Hands on my shoulders, got me covered up
Every inch she knows I'd miss
Back of my neck, and then a kiss
Nobody looks out for me like this
SPF love

[Bridge: beat thins out, voice close]
Reapply every two hours
That's the rule, and it's ours

[Final Chorus: full groove, trumpet on top]
That's SPF love
Hands on my shoulders, got me covered up
Every inch she knows I'd miss
Back of my neck, and then a kiss
Nobody looks out for me like this
SPF love

[Outro: trumpet alone, water lapping]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 118 BPM, 4/4, A major. A relaxed, swaying tropical house pulse, sunny and unhurried.

VOICE: Male tenor, light and smiling, with a gentle Caribbean lilt in the phrasing. Sung softly, close to the microphone, with one harmony above in the choruses. No big notes.

INSTRUMENTS: A muted trumpet playing the main hook, congas and bongos, a soft four-on-the-floor kick, off-beat clean guitar chords, a warm round bass, marimba, handclaps, a little acoustic piano.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, trumpet and congas. 0:12 Verse 1. 0:36 Pre-chorus. 0:42 Chorus 1. 1:06 Drop, trumpet and marimba. 1:22 Verse 2. 1:46 Chorus 2. 2:10 Bridge, beat thin. 2:22 Final chorus. 2:46 Outro, trumpet and water, ends 3:00.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2014 tropical house: clean, warm and spacious, soft-edged drums, trumpet dry and close, nothing harsh.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The trumpet hook answering 'SPF love' at 0:44.

STATION FIT: 11 a.m., the first sunscreen of the day. Warm, mid-tempo and vocal-led, an easy step up from the morning instrumentals. Mixes cleanly with other 116 to 120 BPM tropical tracks.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Looked after, grateful, playful, settled.
